subject: Pilot credits + per-token breakpoints for NovusHealth POC
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot credits + per-token breakpoints for NovusHealth POC

Hi Ethan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together two options for a short pilot (30 days) that balance a small upfront commit (to align incentives) with free credits and per-token breakpoints for volume. High level:

Option A — Light commit + larger free credit
- 3-month window (30-day active pilot + warming)
- $10k committed spend over 90 days (covers base tokens)
- $20k free credits applied on kickoff (usable only against hosted API tokens)
- Per-token pricing after credits: tiered breakpoints, starting at $0.0009/token and stepping down at 250M tokens and 1B tokens

Option B — Larger commit, steeper breakpoints
- 6-month window with staged rollouts
- $50k committed spend (monthly ramp)
- $15k free credits on Day 1
- Lower per-token floor: $0.0006/token after 1B tokens

Attachments: I’ve attached a draft term sheet (pilot_terms_v2.pdf) and a simple pricing calc that maps projected traffic to effective $/token (novus_pricing_calc.xlsx).

Ask: can you confirm which option maps to your internal approval bar? If helpful, we can convert Option A to a pure credit grant with a slightly higher minimum commit. Also happy to join procurement to walk through the DocuSign route — we typically do a one-page SOW + payment schedule for pilots.

Next steps: if you’re comfortable, I’ll send a DocuSign with the chosen option and lock in kickoff dates.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novushealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + per-token breakpoints for NovusHealth POC

Priya —

Thanks for the crisp options. Quick clarifying questions from our side:
1) Is the $20k free credit in Option A an upfront invoice credit (we pay the $10k commit and credits are applied) or is it a pre-paid voucher tied to proof-of-use?
2) What happens to unused credits after the 3/6 month windows?
3) We have a strict cap at $60k for initial vendor approvals — Option B might push that limit unless we stretch the timeframe.

Also, our security team has a short checklist — are there any additional charges for activity-based logs or audit exports during the pilot?

If you can confirm the handling of credits and whether we can do a 90-day Option B variant (reduce the commit to $30k but keep stepped breakpoints), that would help.

Appreciate it,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Head of AI Platforms, NovusHealth
ethan.cole@novushealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@novushealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + per-token breakpoints for NovusHealth POC

Ethan / Priya —

Quick answers to the bullets and a suggested alternative that stays under your $60k approval cap:

1) Credit mechanics — the $20k free credit is a billing credit applied against invoices; Novus would invoice/pay the $10k commit, and the credit reduces the invoice outstanding until exhausted. Unused credits expire at the end of the pilot window (we can set a 30-day grace to use leftover credits).
2) Audit logs — no additional charge for standard audit exports or token-level logs during the pilot. If you want real-time streaming of logs to your SIEM (push), that’s an add-on we can price separately.
3) Alternative proposal (90-day mid-commit):
- Commit: $30k payable net 30
- Free credits: $15k applied Day 1
- Pilot window: 90 days
- Per-token tiers: $0.00095/token up to 250M; $0.00075/token 250M-1B; $0.00055/token >1B
- SLA: standard pilot SLA; full enterprise SLA only after Dedicated purchase
This keeps your cash outlay under $60k while giving you stronger breakpoints than Option A.
If that looks good I’ll prep the one-page SOW and have legal/finance run the POC billing terms.
Thanks,
Karthik
Head of GTM — West, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_terms_v2.pdf (redline-ready), novus_pricing_calc.xlsx

Ethan —

Thanks for the quick review and for flagging the procurement cap. We’ll move forward with the 90-day mid-commit (summary below) and I’ll send a DocuSign link this afternoon.

Summary (agreed):
- Commit: $30,000 (net 30)
- Free credits: $15,000 applied on Day 1 of pilot
- Pilot window: 90 days + 30-day grace to consume credits on production invoices
- Per-token tiers: $0.00095/token up to 250M; $0.00075/token 250M-1B; $0.00055/token >1B
- Audit logs: standard exports included; streaming SIEM is optional add-on
Action items:
- I’ll send the DocuSign one-pager (SOW + payment schedule) — please sign and route to procurement.
- Karthik / Marissa will standby for kickoff scheduling and contact for technical onboarding.
